description.value: Jackson's Resto Butcher is a family-owned Kitsilano institution operating since 1911, originally a butcher shop and expanded in 2020 into a full neighbourhood restaurant. Cyclists on the West 4th Avenue corridor can stop for a hot meal of smoked and grilled meats, burgers, or salads, or grab provisions from the butcher and deli counter to take on the road. BC craft beers on tap, craft cider, and a selection of BC wines round out the stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM address and phone number. The business is a hybrid resto-butcher: a restaurant serving smoked and grilled meats, burgers, and salads alongside a take-home butcher and deli counter, confirming hot food and basic grocery availability. Neither bike parking nor water bottle refill are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so both remain null.
concerns: OSM email (whitney@jacksonsrestobutcher.com) does not match the GM contact shown on the website (michelle@jacksonsrestobutcher.com); the OSM email appears outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, long-established neighbourhood restaurant and butcher on West 4th Avenue — a major cycling corridor through Kitsilano — offering hot food and take-home provisions well-suited to touring cyclists.

provenance.category_correction_reason: The business is equally a full-service neighbourhood restaurant and a butcher/deli shop; 'Groceries' captures the take-home butcher counter but understates the prominent restaurant component.

Hot food.detail: Full restaurant menu includes in-house smoked and grilled meats, burgers, wings, ribs, salads, and vegetarian options; takeout available by phone
